units.source_text: “他是个看门人，谁都得经过这道关卡才能进去呀。”

en.t: He is the gatekeeper, and everyone has to pass through this checkpoint to get in.

units.source_text: 真一又笑了几声，“不过，如果你不愿意这样，咱们就分别进去，在院里的樱花树下相会好了。

en.t: Shinichi laughed a few more times. “But if you do not want to do that, we can go in separately and meet under the cherry tree in the garden.

units.source_text: 好在那些花，即便是独自一个人，也是百看不厌。”

en.t: Fortunately, those blossoms are something you never tire of seeing, even when you are alone.”
